summary: Feed s178_triple to 10G NDR is degraded: 3 faults found - traffic is 98.9% encrypted (above 90% tolerance), 17.1 Gbps microburst overloads 10G port (171% capacity), and 19% of frames are sliced to 192 bytes preventing full-payload inspection.

findings.root_cause: 99% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) with no broker decryption or key forwarding; NDR tolerates ~90% encrypted before detection degrades.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to payload content - cannot perform deep packet inspection, JA3, or payload-based detection; only metadata visible.

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs cleartext payload for detection; decrypt at broker with HSM/keys or forward session keys to NDR to bring encrypted share below 90% threshold.

findings.root_cause: 1ms microburst peaked at 17.10 Gbps on a 10 Gbps NDR port (171% of capacity) - aggregate feed not load-balanced or shaped to tool speed.
findings.impact_on_tool: Tool NIC buffers overflow and drops packets during bursts; NDR misses flows and alerts, creating detection gaps despite no broker drops yet.

recommended_fix.why: Spread 17+ Gbps bursts across 2x10G NDR ports/instances with flow-aware hashing to keep per-port utilization below 80% and prevent drops.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing/packet trimming enabled with snaplen ~192 bytes; 1399 of 7351 frames (19.0%) are cut short.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload (needs_full_payload=true) for signature matching and file extraction; sliced packets break reassembly and hide payloads.

recommended_fix.why: Disable slicing or increase snaplen to tool max 9216 bytes so NDR receives complete L4 payload for detection.
